title: Senior Fullstack Engineer, Customer Context
description_html:
Headquarters: Remote

Postscript is the AI messaging platform trusted by 20,000+ Shopify brands — including Brooklinen, Ruggable, True Classic, and Dr. Squatch. 

With a mission to make SMS your number one revenue driving channel, we built the best-in-class SMS marketing platform and launched revenue-driving AI features not available on any other platform. And we're just getting started. 

Backed by Greylock and Y Combinator, fully remote since 2018.

We are looking for a polyglot Senior Fullstack Engineer to join the Customer Context  team. You’ll help build and scale the foundational services, APIs, and pipelines that power the Postscript product. This role blends strong backend engineering skills with a deep appreciation for data intensive systems, performance, and reliability. You’ll collaborate closely with other software engineers, data engineers, and product to help e-commerce marketers maximize their revenue with best-in-class targeting and context-driven AI.

This is a high-autonomy role for engineers who are energized by ambiguity, take genuine ownership of their work, and bring a strong point of view on how to build things well, without sacrificing speed or pragmatism. AI isn't a nice-to-have here — it's central to how we work. We expect our engineers to be active practitioners of AI-first development: fluent with the latest agentic coding tools, curious about what's emerging, and constantly pushing the boundary of what's possible with AI in their day-to-day craft. If you're the kind of engineer who's already experimenting with new models and tooling before anyone asks you to, you'll feel at home here.

As a senior engineer at Postscript, you’ll no longer be only writing code but orchestrating it. 

This position is fully remote and can be based in the US or Canada.

What You'll Do

  • Take deep ownership of systems and product areas on your team, and become the go-to technical expert for what you own
  • Independently investigate, design, and execute solutions across distributed systems with a high degree of ambiguity
  • Architect, build, and maintain highly available, scalable REST APIs and backend services for internal and external use
  • Drive system decoupling, modularization, and technical debt reduction.. Improve long-term maintainability without blocking near-term delivery
  • Build agentically as your default: leveraging concurrent autonomous agent workflows, owning the output, and keeping a steady queue of aligned work moving
  • Stay at the forefront of emerging AI tooling and practices, bringing new techniques back to the team and helping raise the floor for how Postscript engineers work
  • Contribute to how we think about integrating AI into our systems and workflows. That means not just using AI tools, but helping shape where and how AI creates leverage across the engineering org
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, data, and go-to-market teams by communicating clearly and proactively in an async-first environment
  • Identify and eliminate single points of failure, improving system resilience and knowledge redundancy across your team
  • Improve how engineering gets done: bring better tools, fix workflow friction, build internal utilities when the leverage compounds

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of experience building large-scale data-intensive backend systems and APIs
  • You are an active, daily user of AI coding tools and are using them to maximize your output — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent — and can speak concretely to how they've changed your output and your workflow
  • Some or all of these languages: Python, Go, Rust, React, and TypeScript
  • You follow the AI tooling landscape closely: new model releases, emerging agentic workflows, and evolving best practices aren't things you catch up on eventually.
  • You think critically about AI output and you know where it accelerates you, where it introduces risk, and how to verify what it produces
  • You are able to context switch quickly across concurrent workstreams
  • Experience working on both 0-to-1 initiatives and complex existing systems, and knowing how to balance building new things with improving what's there
  • You have working knowledge of event-driven distributed systems, Kafka, and familiarity with distributed data processing technologies (Flink/Spark/etc)
  • Experience growing systems under production customer load, ideally from early days to the multi-terabyte stage
  • Experience building and designing high-scale systems AWS with a broad variety of database technologies (RDBMS, OLAP, NoSQL, etc.)
  • You know how to intelligently model relational data and design index strategies. You write performant SQL for transactional and analytical workloads
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (eg, Terraform). You are comfortable evaluating and applying your infra changes.
  • Familiarity building and observing applications on AWS & Kubernetes, ideally with Datadog, Signoz, or comparable observability tooling
  • Clear, direct communication. Cross-functional partners and async teams can count on you to surface information proactively
  • Strong instincts for technical tradeoffs informed by both engineering best practices and business priorities

What You'll Love About Us

  • Salary range of USD $175,000–$220,000 base plus significant equity (we do not have geo-based salaries)
  • High growth startup — plenty of room for you to directly impact the company and grow your career
  • Work from home (or wherever in US / Canada)
  • Fun — we're passionate and enjoy what we do
  • Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Health, dental, vision insurance

For information about how we use your personal data, please see our U.S. Job Applicant Privacy Notice

You are welcome here. Postscript is an ever-evolving place of equal employment for talented individuals.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/postscript-senior-fullstack-engineer-customer-context

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (SDEV)
description_html:
Headquarters: Remote (USA - New York City, NY)

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

 

PagerDuty is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (SRE Agent) to join our customer-focused SRE Agent team! As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work inside PagerDuty’s largest customer accounts, connecting the SRE Agent to their production environments (observability tools, infrastructure as code, GitOps tooling, and CI/CD pipelines) and guiding their teams from AI-assisted incident response to supervised and autonomous actions with safety guardrails. You will also contribute code directly back to the core SRE Agent product, building reusable tools, connectors, and skills derived from real customer needs.

This is an exciting opportunity to join the product engineering team as the Staff Engineer and directly shape how agentic AI operates within the most strategic customers. The ideal candidate brings a strong background as a software engineer, hands-on experience shipping LLM/agentic systems to production, and the customer-facing skills to bridge technical execution with business strategy.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Embed and drive SRE Agent adoption: Work onsite and in regular contact with 2–4 strategic customer teams to deploy the SRE Agent, configure tools and connectors, and embed AI actions across their incident management lifecycle to drive adoption and value 
  • Build and contribute core agent capabilities: Scope, design, and build reusable agent tools, connectors, and skills on the agent’s extensibility surfaces, shipping them through the product team's repos, review process, and evaluation gates.
  • Run pilots and unblock customer adoption: Stand up new agentic capabilities with strategic accounts first, gather eval data, identify technical blockers (permissions, telemetry, missing connectors), and build production fixes directly into the product.
  • Integrate with production stacks and progressive delivery: Connect the SRE Agent to IaC (Terraform, Pulumi), GitOps (ArgoCD), CI/CD pipelines, and observability platforms, guiding customers safely from AI-assisted to autonomous operations.
  • Set technical direction and feedback insights: Define 3–6 month technical roadmaps across assigned accounts, provide architectural guidance to product managers and engineering managers, and bring customer friction and eval data back to the core team.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years of experience building and shipping production software across team boundaries (assessed against PagerDuty Staff Engineer / SDE V expectations).
  • Hands-on experience with LLM and agent systems in production, including agent development, tool-use frameworks (MCP or equivalent), evaluation pipelines, and guardrail design.
  • Customer-facing skills. You can run a technical design session with a customer’s engineers and present the business case to their leadership.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. You can start from a vague problem statement in an unfamiliar environment and get to working software without much direction. Former founders and founding engineers tend to do well in this role.
  • A record of shipping software that got adopted, and the judgment to recognize which customer requests generalize and when the right answer is not to build.
  • Infrastructure & Deployment expertise: Demonstrated experience with Terraform or Pulumi at scale, GitOps (ArgoCD or equivalent), CI/CD pipeline design, and progressive delivery patterns (canary, blue/green, soak periods).
  • Willingness to travel 25–50% during active customer engagements.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Practical operational knowledge of incident management and observability concepts (on-call, postmortems, SLOs/SLIs, alerting).
  • Customer-facing technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or solutions architecture experience on top of a core software engineering background.
  • Background as a founder or founding engineer accustomed to navigating high ambiguity and driving unscripted problem-solving.
  • Experience with policy-as-code, fine-grained permissioning, or safety guardrail patterns for agent-driven automation.
  • Production experience with PagerDuty or competing digital operations and incident management platforms.
  • Active open-source contributions to the AI agent or Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem.

 

The base salary range for this position is $191,000 - $289,300 USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission, equity, and/or benefits.

Our base salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific offerings for this role, as well as the salary range for your primary work location during the hiring process.

 

 

Hesitant to apply?

We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for job alerts!

Where we work

PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we cannot employ candidates residing in:

Location restrictions:
Australia: Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia
Canada: Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon
United States: Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming
Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role.

How we work

Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.

People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.

What we offer

As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country-specific offerings, on our benefits site.

Your package may include:

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive benefits package 
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Company equity*
  • ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Program)*
  • Retirement or pension plan*
  • Generous paid vacation time
  • Paid holidays and sick leave
  • Dutonian Wellness Days & HibernationDuty - companywide paid days off in addition to PTO
  • Paid parental leave: 22 weeks for pregnant parent, 12 weeks for non-pregnant parent (some countries have longer leave standards and we comply with local laws)*
  • Paid volunteer time off: 20 hours per year
  • Company-wide hack weeks
  • Mental wellness programs

*Eligibility may vary by role, region, and tenure

About PagerDuty

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. The PagerDuty Operations Cloud is an AI-powered platform that empowers business resilience and drives operational efficiency for enterprises. With a generative AI assistant at its core, PagerDuty empowers teams to detect and resolve issues in real time, orchestrate complex workflows, and drive continuous improvement across their digital operations. Trusted by nearly half of both the Fortune 500 and the Forbes AI 50, as well as approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100, PagerDuty is essential for delivering always-on digital experiences to modern businesses

PagerDuty is Great Place to Work-certified™, a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, a Fortune Best Medium Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace in Technology, and a top rated product on TrustRadius and G2. 

Go behind-the-scenes on our careers site and @pagerduty on Instagram.

Additional Information

PagerDuty is an equal opportunity employer. PagerDuty does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or disability status. Your privacy is important to us. By submitting an application, you confirm that you have read and understand PagerDuty's Privacy Policy.

PagerDuty is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application process. Should you require accommodation, please email accommodation@pagerduty.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

PagerDuty uses the E-Verify employment verification program.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pagerduty-forward-deployed-engineer-sdev

title: Senior Software Engineer, Self-Host Orchestration
description_html:
Headquarters: Remote, U.S.
URL: https://bitwarden.com

 

Bitwarden empowers enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely store and share sensitive data. With a transparent, open-source approach to password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations, Bitwarden makes it easy for users to extend robust security practices across all online activities. Founded in 2016 with headquarters in Santa Barbara, California, Bitwarden is supported by a passionate global community of security experts and enthusiasts. 

As a Software Engineer on the Self-host Orchestration team at Bitwarden, you will directly contribute to projects that our customers use to deploy Bitwarden into their infrastructure. You’ll be a part of the team that builds and maintains the packaging, testing, and deployment for our self-host product, including our Helm chart project. This role also offers the opportunity to interact directly with our open source community through pull request and triaging community issues. This is an all remote team and we are looking for a US based engineer. We don not offer sponsorship at this time

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Be the expert and authority on our Self-host Helm charts and our wider self-host architecture including: backend infrastructure, APIs, database, web app, and how the mobile apps, browser extensions, desktop apps, interact with self-host

  • Build and maintain our Self-host Helm charts and self-host infrastructure, delivery pipeline, automation, SDLC and development practices.

  • Collaborate with the rest of the team on system design for our owned tools and codebase.

  • Collaborate closely with our Implementation Engineering and Customer Success teams to understand client needs and implement technical solutions to address them

  • Build and maintain tools that deploy & test our self-host stacks on diverse infrastructure setups

  • Participate in hands-on development of Bitwarden products

  • Use, maintain, and augment or AI skills and infrastructure as part of our AI-driven product delivery lifecycle.

  • Participate in code reviews, learning and spreading technical knowledge

  • Contribute bug fixes for issues submitted by the user community

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

  • High proficiency with containerization and container orchestrators, such as Kubernetes with experience with at least one cloud hosted Kubernetes service (EKS, AKS, GKE)

  • Proficiency creating and maintaining Helm charts

  • Experience with Argo CD, Fluxcd, or alternative GitOps delivery tools

  • Proficiency with at least one cloud platform, Azure preferred 

  • Proficiency with Git and dependency management 

  • Experience writing code in at least one programming language, .NET or Python preferred

  • Proficiency with Linux server administration including Nginx and Bash and/or PowerShell scripting

  • Excellent communication skills, collaborative mindset, and a zeal for learning — your first phase will be learning everything you can from other team members and documentation

NICE-TO-HAVES

  • User of Bitwarden

  • Startup experience

  • Open source experience

  • Remote work experience within an Agile sprint-based project management workflow 

  • Experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions

  • Experience self-hosting; extra points for experience self-hosting Bitwarden and/or self-hosting on Windows

  • Experience with Ansible, Terraform, Packer, etc.

  • Experience with Kubernetes security

 

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

Selected candidates will be invited to schedule a 30-minute screening call and then progress through the following stages: 

  • Interview with Hiring Manager

  • A take-home test where you can show off your skills

  • Interview with the Team

  • Additional Interviews as required

 

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

  • Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.

  • Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.

  • We are dedicated to building an incredible team. Work remotely with motivated and innovative team members and take part in productive and fun meetups.

  • Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team.

 

We recognize and understand that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications for the position, you should still consider applying. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. Please let us know if you require accommodations during the interview process.

 

In the United States, the starting base compensation range for this role is $140,000 - $150,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, relevant experience, and skill set as assessed in the interview process, as well as market data by location. See our careers page for a list of benefits. Please note that compensation outside the U.S. will differ based on the market.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bitwarden-senior-software-engineer-self-host-orchestration

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Privy
